_meta.note: First version of this domain — created 2026-09-06 closing T3.8's 'register with declared targets' half. ContentMetrics.cs's own doc comment is explicit that a richer numeric target (how many affixes SHOULD exist per family, what fill rate counts as healthy) is a balance judgement nobody has made yet, and this file does not invent one. The two gates below are structural floors already implied by the pure metric shapes themselves (FamilyCoverage/ContainerFillRate.MeetsBudget), not authored numbers: a family with atoms but zero referencing affixes, and a container pool that cannot fill its own declared roll budget. Both gates ship false (measure-only) — the same 'new metrics are measure-only until calibrated' rule seedsmith's own W1 registry already established (tools/seedsmith/seedsmith/report/cli.py) — so AffixMetricsGate --gate is clean today by construction, not because nothing was found; run it WITHOUT --gate to see the real findings.
_meta.rebalance: Never hand-edit this file by hand once a v2 exists. python tools/tuning/publish.py affix-metrics <dotted.key>=<value> writes affix-metrics.v{n+1}.json; the old version stays on disk for revert.
